impact.text: Loss of funds from liquidations/trades based on corrupted prices

precondition_sources.text: Ekubo is deployed on an L2 chain with a centralized sequencer.
The L2 sequencer stops producing blocks for a period lasting minutes to hours.
While the sequencer is down, block.timestamp is frozen and does not advance with the real-world clock.
When the sequencer restarts, it processes the backlog of pending transactions, all executing with the same stale block.timestamp from when the sequencer went down.

intent_sources.text: On L2 deployments, the oracle must validate sequencer uptime status before recording snapshots, rather than blindly trusting block.timestamp.
